free_tier.stated: USD 200 of free credit for a new public-cloud account, one time; there is no free instance tier, and b3-8 at $0.0605 an hour is the cheapest general-purpose row

limits.value: $0.0605 an hour for b3-8 at 2 vCore and 8 GB, up to $4.829 for b3-640 at 160 vCore
public network bandwidth is fixed per instance size, from 500 Mbit/s to 20 Gbit/s, so the egress ceiling is bought with the instance
the USD 200 is a one-time new-account credit; there is no free tier under it

identity_cost.detail: A valid email address is the only requirement the account-creation guide lists, but the free trial cannot start before a valid payment method is added, and creating the first project carries a USD 0.99 fee. The trial credit is limited to the US regions. No phone number and no identity document is named.

confidence_note: the public-cloud price list was read on 2026-10-22 and carries both the USD 200 trial credit and the full instance ladder. The credit is one-time, so the verdict stays trial-only and the ladder gives the duty-cycle arithmetic

the free trial cannot start before a valid payment method is added to the account
